annotations.title: Render a print-ready poster around one QR

description: Wrap one QR design in a print-ready poster: a4/a5/a6/letter trim, four layouts (minimal, band, card, tent), headline, instruction line, footer, optional logo, 3 mm bleed and crop marks. Returns a vector PDF by default (ready for a print shop) or a png preview at 36-300 dpi. Useful for a table card, a shop window or a hotel desk. The design fields are the same qr_generate takes; fileFormat is the poster's own format, not the code's.

accentColor.description: Brand colour for the headline, band and card border (hex). Defaults to the frame or module colour.

additionalConfig.description: Escape hatch: any other QrConfig field the engine accepts. Merged on top of the design fields.

bleed.description: Add a 3 mm bleed around the trim. Recommended for professional printing.

content.description: The text or URL the QR will encode. Required.

cropMarks.description: Draw crop marks outside the trim.

dpi.description: Resolution of a png poster, 36-300 dpi. Ignored for pdf.

fileFormat.description: Poster output. Defaults to "pdf" (vector, print-ready); "png" is a raster preview.

finderInnerShape.description: Shape of the inner dot of the three corner finder patterns.

finderOuterShape.description: Shape of the outer ring of the three corner finder patterns.

footer.description: Small footer under the poster (website, short URL). Blank: none.

frameText.description: Label inside the frame, max 40 characters.

headline.description: Large title above the QR. Blank: none.

instruction.description: Short line under the QR (e.g. "Point your camera at the code"). Blank: none.

logoUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL of a logo image to embed in the design.

moduleShape.description: Shape of the small modules in the QR matrix.

outputHeight.description: Height of the code inside the poster, in pixels for a png poster. 64-4096.

outputWidth.description: Width of the code inside the poster, in pixels for a png poster. 64-4096.

posterFormat.description: Trim size, portrait. Defaults to a4.

posterLayout.description: Poster layout around the code. Defaults to minimal.

showLogo.description: Draw the design's logo at the top of the poster. Defaults to true.

text.description: Optional caption rendered below the QR.

name: qr_poster

dpi.description: Raster resolution, when the output is a png.

posterFormat.description: Trim size used (a4, a5, a6, letter).

resourceUri.description: URI of the embedded PDF resource. PDFs cannot be inlined, so the file travels as a resource block.

title: Render a print-ready poster around one QR
